scripts.deploy: cd dist && git init -q && git checkout -B gh-pages -q && git add -A && git -c user.email="deploy@local" -c user.name="deploy bot" commit -q -m "Deploy $(date -u +%FT%TZ)" && git push -fq $(cd .. && git remote get-url origin) HEAD:gh-pages && cd .. && rm -rf dist/.git && echo Deploy OK
